# Plain Text Ledger

> An independent, factual guide to EditPad Lite 8: what the free edition covers, what a work licence costs, how it differs from EditPad Pro and where to download it from the vendor.

Independent guides to Editpadlite by Aleksej Palivoda. Facts come from the vendor's pages on the date shown on each page.

## Start
- [EditPad Lite download: version 8.6.1 from the official site](https://editpadlite.github.io/download.html): Download EditPad Lite 8.6.1 from the vendor: 18 MB installer, Windows XP to 11, free for personal use. Install steps, portable option and licence terms.

## Decide
- [EditPad Lite review: a small Windows text editor with clear limits](https://editpadlite.github.io/review.html): EditPad Lite 8.6.1 reviewed from the vendor's documentation: what the free edition does, the 2 GB file limit, what Pro adds and the 24.95 euro licence.
- [EditPad Lite pricing: free for personal use, 24.95 euro for work](https://editpadlite.github.io/pricing.html): EditPad Lite pricing from the vendor's purchase page: 24.95 euro for one user, volume tiers to 100 users, 12.95 euro upgrades, 3 month money back guarantee.
- [Is EditPad Lite free? Personal use versus the paid licence](https://editpadlite.github.io/free-vs-paid.html): EditPad Lite is free for home and school use that earns no income. See what the 24.95 euro licence adds: work use, spell checker, files over 2 GB, forum.
- [EditPad Lite refund policy: the three month money back guarantee](https://editpadlite.github.io/refund-policy.html): EditPad Lite has a three month unconditional money back guarantee. How to ask for a refund, what the vendor does not state, and how upgrades are covered.

## Compare
- [EditPad Lite vs EditPad Pro: what the extra 25 euro buys](https://editpadlite.github.io/editpad-lite-vs-editpad-pro.html): EditPad Lite vs EditPad Pro compared from the vendor's own pages: file size limits, column selection, macros, FTP, file compare, prices and upgrade cost.
- [EditPad Lite alternatives: six text editors to compare](https://editpadlite.github.io/alternatives.html): Six EditPad Lite alternatives with licence and platform facts from each official site: EditPad Pro, Notepad++, PSPad, VS Code, Sublime Text, UltraEdit.

## Do it
- [EditPad Lite portable: how to put it on a USB drive](https://editpadlite.github.io/portable-install.html): Make EditPad Lite portable with Help > Create Portable Installation or the installer: steps, the EditPadLite8 folder, where settings go, and the limits.
- [EditPad Lite system requirements: Windows versions, Linux and Mac](https://editpadlite.github.io/system-requirements.html): EditPad Lite 8 runs on Windows XP through Windows 11, 32 and 64 bit. No native Linux or Mac version; the vendor documents running it on Linux with Wine.
